div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1. Define the contract
What must be true when push returns?
Which failures must the record survive?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2. Direct append
Every caller opens, appends, and closes the file.
What breaks when two threads write concurrently?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. Serialize with a mutex
Which operations belong inside the lock?
Does closing the file guarantee durability?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4. Persist each record
Explain flush versus fsync.
When exactly may push return successfully?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5. Frame the records
How do you distinguish arbitrary byte payloads?
How do you handle a short write?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6. Recover after a crash
What if the file ends halfway through a record?
What can a checksum detect—and what can it not guarantee?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
7. Identify the performance bottleneck
Every push holds the mutex through fsync.
What happens with thousands of callers?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
8. Introduce group commit
How can one fsync serve multiple callers?
Design a shared queue and one background writer.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
9. Separate queue coordination from disk I/O
Can callers enqueue while the writer syncs?
Which shared state still requires the mutex?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
10. Acknowledge the correct records
Assign a sequence number to each accepted record.
Syncing 1–100 while 101 arrives: who may return?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
11. Coordinate waiting callers
How does a condition variable work?
Why must callers recheck a predicate after waking?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
12. Bound batching latency
What if traffic stops below the size threshold?
When does the batch deadline start?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
13. Apply backpressure
What if producers outrun the disk?
Do queued and in-flight bytes both count?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
14. Handle permanent failure
fsync fails: what state changes?
How do durability and capacity waiters escape?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
15. Explain uncertain outcomes
Can a failed push still leave a valid record?
What happens if the caller retries?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
16. Shut down safely
close races with push: which records are accepted?
How do you drain them without deadlocking?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
17. Validate the guarantees
Inject short writes, sync failures, and crashes.
Why does killing a process not simulate power loss?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
18. Extend the API
If push returns before durability,
how can callers await a durable acknowledgment?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
19. Rotate files safely
How do you coordinate queued records, file switches,
directory syncs, recovery, and acknowledgments?
